original.caption:
Want a CHANCE TO WIN an extra $50 Gift Voucher? (Facebook Exclusive!)
 Like this post
 Share this post
 Tag a friend in the comments below who you want to bring with you!

 CONTEST ALERT: WIN YOUR MEAL! 
Enjoy a meal at Island Chef Downtown (62 Queen Street, Charlottetown) and your next visit could be on us!  
How to enter:
 Dine in with us and write your name and phone number on the back of your receipt.  
 Draw Dates: 2026 November 16th and December 1st for a $100 gift voucher each !  
 Reserve your table: https://reservations.islandchefdowntown.ca/  or call us at 9029268139 to book your table. 
#IslandChefDowntown #CharlottetownEats #PEIFood #ContestAlert #WinYourMeal
#charlottetownpei #stratfordpei #townofthreerivers #explorepei #princeedwardislnd
